entities.summary: Mirzhan Beybutovich Rakhimzhanov is a boxer from Kazakhstan. He competed for his native country at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, Greece, where he was stopped in the second round of the flyweight division by Russia's Georgy Balakshin. Mirzhan Rakhimzhanov was a athletes & competitors from Semey (b. 1983-04-11, Semey). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
